_comment: MacroTilt data element registry per project Data Steward standards. Every element on the live site has source, ingestion mode, owner, cadence, freshness SLA, and registered consumers. v2 (2026-05-12) is the first pass that backfills the registry from 8 entries (v1) to all 75 feeds catalogued in DATA_LINEAGE_2026-05-12.md. Feeds with cadence='unknown — needs verification' are flagged in the _open_questions block below. v3 (2026-05-15) adds the MacroTilt 2-axis engine snapshot as a derived indicator element. Engine validated 1986-2026 (locked 2026-05-13). v4 (2026-05-20) registers the two Phase 1 data feeds for the rebuilt Trading Opportunities screener: scanner.darkpool-prints-uw and scanner.options-eod-uw. v6 (2026-05-21) records the Trading Opportunities dark-pool and options scoring engines going live (darkpool_scoring.py / options_scoring.py): both feeds move from “engine not yet built” to a live consumer; the screener score ceiling rises 5 -> 10. v5 (2026-05-21) records the Macro Overview data-quality correction pass: IG OAS re-pointed from the BAA-minus-DGS10 proxy to the canonical ICE BofA series (BAMLC0A0CM); IG OAS, the HY/IG ratio, and the commercial-paper spread moved off period-end resampling that was publishing future-dated stamps; the copper/gold ratio rescaled to the desk convention (x1000); and term-premium cadence corrected to daily. v7 (2026-05-22) registers news.market-headlines-multisource, the Home market-news headlines feed, after a SCAN_345PM idempotency-gate shell syntax error silently froze it at 2026-05-19. v8 (2026-05-22) moves that feed from the once-a-day scanner bake to an on-demand endpoint (api/macro-news.js), fetched on page load and CDN-cached ~10 min. v9 (2026-05-25) records the #1208 fix to the Trading Opportunities screener's prices_eod cold pull: the cross-run resume now paginates one ticker at a time (index-served range scans, no PostgREST or= disjunction that timed out) and mirrors the completed price panel to a durable Supabase Storage backstop (bucket screener-cache). v10 (2026-06-11) honest-stamp one-shot: +12 previously-untracked elements registered; stamp semantics fixed across all producers (last_good_at = real run time; data_as_of = business date, never future). v11 (2026-06-11) un-registered put_call/buffett/bank_unreal (killed 2026-06-10; mistakenly re-registered same day). v12 (2026-06-11 PM): normalized 37 daily market-series SLAs 73h->49h to the documented daily standard (the 73h padding predated honest close-anchored stamps + the 16:30 ET EOD chain and is no longer needed); corrected stale fetch times (scanner 15:30->03:30 overnight run; allocation ->08:15 per its workflow cron). v13 (2026-06-11 PM, Joe SLA doctrine): stale = >24h past due. Same-evening dailies 49h; T+1-publishing FRED dailies 73h (documented basis per element); COT 504h->192h. Monthly/quarterly extended budgets allowed only for documented publication lags — per-series calibration queued. v14 (2026-07-07) Conviction-Insider rebuild: dark-pool + options SHELVED from the trading-opps screener SCORE (unvalidated, weeks of history only); run_screener.py composite now = insider + trend, ceiling 10->5. Both feeds stay ingested and surface as informational context columns/drill reads. Paper engine retired score-tiered sizing + 2x leverage for fixed $100K equal-weight + hysteresis hold-to-<3.
_freshness_sla_basis: One-clock (FRESHNESS_CHIP_SPEC 2026-06-16): freshness_sla_hours is the JOB's run cadence + grace, NOT the data's publication lag. The chip grades green/red off the LAST PULL (pipeline_health.last_good_at, the job's real last successful run) vs this SLA, calendar-aware so weekends/holidays never count. Daily job = 49h (~2 business days). Weekly job = 192h. Bi-monthly (FINRA) = 480h. Monthly job = 768h. Quarterly job = 2400h. A lagged data series (e.g. a monthly read by the daily job) stays GREEN while the daily job pulls — its weeks-old as_of no longer reds the chip.

indicator.composite-share-badge and indicator.license-tier-badge — these are hand-curated metadata reads (dataRegistry.js + this file), not separate feeds. Listed under infra for completeness.

screener.trading-opps-signals.notes: Phase 2 dual-direction screener. Runs the backtest-calibrated engine (insider + trend layers, with the 15-day-plateau insider age-decay) over the eligible universe and appends one dated snapshot per launched name. Append-only: earlier scan_dates are never overwritten. The screener's prices_eod cold pull paginates one ticker at a time (index-served range scans) and caches the completed price panel to GitHub Actions cache plus a durable Supabase Storage backstop (bucket screener-cache, object trading_opps/prices.pkl) so a cache eviction cannot reproduce a cold-pull outage; steady-state nightly runs do a seconds-long incremental refresh of the latest trade day (#1208).

equity-rsi_divergences-daily.name: rsi_divergences
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.element: RSI divergence scan (daily, liquid US common stocks)
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.refresh_trigger: github-actions: DIVERGENCE_SCAN_DAILY.yml (chains off MASSIVE-DAILY completion + 08:45 ET backup crons)
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.schedule_et: 08:45 ET Tue-Sat, after the T+1 EOD price panel completes
consumer_surfaces: Trading Scanner -> RSI Divergences section -> bullish table
Trading Scanner -> RSI Divergences section -> bearish table
Trading Scanner -> RSI Divergences section -> freshness chip + scan-date line
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.failure_mode: RSI Divergences section holds the last good dated scan and its chip reds; two consecutive failures raise the pipeline watchdog P1.
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.sla_basis: Joe 2026-06-11 doctrine: daily cadence, next-morning compute + 24h grace = 49h
equity-rsi_divergences-daily.notes: Inputs, one provider per source: (1) prices_eod [Polygon Massive EOD OHLCV, already registered as market.prices-eod-massive] for bars and liquidity; (2) universe_master [Polygon Massive reference] for the common-stock-only filter. Transform: RSI(14) on daily closes, simple-average method (Cutler); pivot lows/highs need 5 bars each side and 5 later bars to confirm; regular divergences only on the two most recent confirmed pivots (bullish: lower price low with higher RSI low; bearish: higher price high with lower RSI high); newer pivot within 15 bars; pivots 5-30 bars apart. Data-quality guards: pivot price ratio > 1.8x dropped (splits/artifacts), current close outside 0.5x-2x of the newer pivot dropped, close-vs-vwap disagreement > 50% on the scan day drops the ticker, ADV capped at $40B in the universe SQL, and the trading-day window counts only panel-complete days (>= 5,000 tickers). Universe: type CS active, last close >= $2, 45-trading-day avg dollar volume >= $50M, >= 40 of 45 days present (~1,500 names). Port validated 2026-07-13 against the prototype's reference run: 17/17 names reproduced with matching RSI values. Append-only across scan_dates; delete+rewrite within a scan_date (idempotent).

screener.power-trend-list.element: Power Trend sleeve monthly ranked list (63-day ROC breakout screen, max 15 names)
screener.power-trend-list.refresh_trigger: github-actions: POWER-TREND-LIST-MONTHLY.yml (1st of month 06:00 ET crons + workflow_dispatch)
screener.power-trend-list.schedule_et: 06:00 ET on the 1st of each month (schedule-normalization: monthly-on-the-1st slow-data slot)
consumer_surfaces: Trading Scanner -> Power Trend Momentum Scanner tile -> ranked list (last close / 1-day / since-list columns are display enrichment read from prices_eod) + meta line + freshness chip
Paper engine -> sleeve M targets (latest rebalance_date of power_trend_list)
Paper page -> sleeve M holdings + rank column
screener.power-trend-list.failure_mode: Power Trend panel holds the last good dated list and its chip reds; the paper engine keeps its last targets and never trades a list past SLA. A zero-signal month is NOT a failure: the producer publishes a single CASH sentinel row (rank=0) the engine reads as all-cash.
screener.power-trend-list.sla_basis: One-clock doctrine: monthly job = 768h; graded off the last successful publish (pipeline_health.last_good_at).
screener.power-trend-list.notes: Replaces the retired 12-1 momentum list (equity-momentum_list-monthly) and the Faber crash guard (market-momentum_guard-daily), both retired 2026-07-15 with their producers deleted (LESSON 0.10). Screen runs server-side in public.power_trend_scan (migration 081, validated logic — do not re-derive client-side): universe = liquid US common stock via strategy_bt_universe (close >= $2, 45-day ADV $50M-$40B); 3-mo ROC = 63 trading days, top-20% cross-sectional; RS gate >= 5 points vs SPY; breakout = new 10-day closing high on > 1.3x 20-day avg volume; close above EMAs 10/21/50/200 (truncated weighted-sum over <= 720 rows, >= 250 required — recursive EMA times out at panel width). adv_usd is in DOLLARS (close x 20-day avg volume), not $M. Producer caps at 15 names (roc_3m desc, ticker-asc tiebreak; scripts/power_trend_rules.py); engine sizing = capital / max(n, 8) — the min-8 diversification floor, unfilled slots stay in cash. Fail-loud gates: PostgREST truncation guard (< 900 rows), <= 200 rows sane, universe >= 800, panel-date consistency, post-write count verification (LESSONS 4.18 / 4.5). Append-only across rebalance_dates; delete+rewrite within one (idempotent).
